# Angler spawn locations including map

![Angler Spawn locations including map](/uploads/679_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Anglers are a possible mutation of angler fish and frogs, sharing the "lure", in the form of a glowing fishing rod on the head, and the upturned jaw of the former and the limbs, proportions and habitat of the latter.

**Anglers are cryptids**, although they do not appear in American folklore like most cryptids. So they also count for the “Kill a Cryptid” challenges. Most importantly, count towards the “Kill an Angler” challenge, which can be a daily challenge or a weekly challenge. 

You will find anglers mainly in the moors and in the Toxic Valley.
